slides.headline: Stop paying for duplicate context windows.
slides.sub: How real-time semantic caching saves 40% on inference costs in multi-provider cascades.

slides.heading: The Cache-First Request Path
slides.mermaid:
graph TD
  A[User Prompt] --> B(Embed Query)
  B --> C{Semantic Cache Hit?}
  C -- Yes --> D[Return Cached Response]
  C -- No --> E[Route to LLM Provider]
  E --> F[Write-Through Cache]
  F --> D

slides.heading: Cache Key From Embedding

slides.label: Lower inference spend
slides.context: Measured across a 3-provider cascade (GPT, Claude, Gemini) after routing repeat-intent queries through a semantic cache with a 0.92 cosine threshold.

slides.heading: Where This Breaks Without Guardrails
items: Threshold too loose: near-duplicate prompts return stale, wrong answers.
No TTL: cached responses outlive the facts they describe.
No provider tagging: a GPT-cached answer gets served for a Claude-routed request.

slides.headline: Follow Sandesh Kale
slides.sub: for more deterministic GenAI systems, one architecture breakdown at a time.
